approval.current_nested: Complete original uses two persisted-Document reviewer_choices forms, projected Employee work list and candidate.user-bound submit/assign. Canonical opaque forms remain available. All original authority/history/timer/notice operations retained.
approval.current_if_composition: Guarding nested form output with ordinary existing require/if business checks can condition complete authorized read results; it cannot observe missing partial sibling draft input or own response-sequence/cancellation lifecycle. No grammar fragment or arbitrary expression added.
approval.current_custom: Same canonical operations can be composed by a controller after custom read serving handoff; it must satisfy the same lifecycle requirements and final opaque input path. Controller code/maintenance cost not implemented or measured.
approval.proposed_minimal: Owning submit/assign form enhances existing generated assignee input through checked reviewer_choices projection of Employee.user and readable labels. Input schema and current mutation authority remain canonical. Original opaque path retained, so empty work viewer list is not a new final candidate-membership rule.
approval.identifiable_authoring_difference: Two duplicate candidate-bound forms/lists can be replaced by two owning-form binding references while keeping the original primary forms. This is persisted-parent presentation reuse, not a new partial-sibling interaction.
approval.nonbenefit: No new parent draft field or dynamic dependency is present in original CanApprove. It already has candidate selection and final role/site/distinct reviewer checks. No adoption/keyboard/request-count advantage observed.

country_region.role: Clearly supplementary complete app with own Geography policy/admin CRUD, country/region canonical read scenarios, immutable own Address mutation, inline guards and both destinations; not an original production app.
country_region.current_nested: Address page contains explicit country_choices -> list Country -> region_choices(bound Country) -> list Region -> save(bound Country+Region), then own saved addresses. Typed canonical final inputs/guards already prevent cross-parent writes.
country_region.current_if_composition: Read guards can prevent invalid complete parent calls; persisted nested selection can be gated but no automatic partial-country-input listener or stale-response fence is supplied by adding if alone.
country_region.current_custom: Single existing save form plus custom lifecycle/controller requirements can reuse same reads. It has same intended interaction as proposed binding; custom read runtime is still gated, controller cost unknown.
country_region.proposed_minimal: Single save form with canonical country/region reference inputs. Proposed region binding maps only typed possibly absent input.country to existing region_choices. No copied types/constraints or arbitrary query expression.
country_region.identifiable_interaction_difference: Address page source has three nested operation form nodes versus one owning save form shell, enabling an explicit partial-country draft prerequisite and one stable form for street/notes while country changes. Automatic clearing/cancellation/context fencing and draft retention are requirements, not observed behavior.
country_region.nonbenefit: Current nested form already checks final Country/Region relation and current allowed/member grants. Proposed binding does not add server authority; raw shell-byte reduction ignores sketch/controller/runtime work.
